Madhyamaheshwar

The second temple of the Panch Kedar circuit — reached on foot from Ransi village through forest and riverside trails in the Garhwal Himalayas.

AT A GLANCE

About the Trek

Madhyamaheshwar is the second temple of the Panch Kedar circuit, reached on foot from Ransi village through forest and riverside trails in the Garhwal Himalayas. The trek covers 18 km to reach the temple, with an optional 2 km sunrise hike further up to Budha Madmaheshwar for breathtaking Himalayan views.

Along the way you'll stop at Devprayag Sangam and Dhari Devi Temple, stay overnight in Ransi village, and camp near the temple itself — a five-day journey that blends pilgrimage with a genuine Himalayan trek.

TREK DISTANCE
18 km from Ransi
BASE VILLAGE
Ransi, Uttarakhand
EXTRA HIKE
2 km to Budha Madmaheshwar
REGION
Garhwal Himalayas
DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

Tap a day to see the full plan.

  • Reporting Point: Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi.
  • Reporting Time: 9:00 PM.
  • Departure Time: 10:00 PM.
  • Briefing: Meet your trek leaders and fellow trekkers, followed by a quick check of essentials and gear.
  • Journey Begins: Start your overnight journey towards Ransi Village.
  • Early Morning: Continue your scenic drive through the Garhwal Himalayas.
  • Devprayag Halt: Witness the sacred confluence of the Alaknanda River and the Bhagirathi River at Devprayag — the birthplace of the Ganga River.
  • Dhari Devi Temple: Seek blessings at the revered Dhari Devi Temple, located on the banks of the Alaknanda.
  • Evening Arrival – Ransi: Reach the serene village of Ransi, surrounded by lush forests.
  • Check-In: Settle into a cozy hostel or homestay.
  • Explore Ransi: After resting, explore the peaceful village, visit the divine Maa Rakeshwari Temple, and end the day with the soulful evening aarti.
  • Dinner: Enjoy a hot, homely local meal.
  • Overnight Stay: Relax in Ransi for the night.
  • Early Morning: Wake up to fresh mountain air and enjoy a wholesome breakfast.
  • Trek Begins (18 km): Start your trek from Ransi towards Madhyamaheshwar through lush forests and riverside trails.
  • En Route: Capture the serene beauty of the Garhwal Himalayas, alpine streams, and peaceful surroundings.
  • Evening Arrival: Reach the sacred Madmaheshwar Temple, feel the spiritual aura, and attend the calming evening aarti.
  • Overnight Stay: Relax at a guesthouse or campsite near the temple.
  • Dinner: Homely dinner will be served at your stay.
  • Early Morning (3 AM): Begin a short 2 km hike to Budha Madmaheshwar for breathtaking Himalayan views and a magical sunrise.
  • Post Hike: Descend back to Madhyamaheshwar, freshen up, and attend the peaceful morning aarti.
  • Breakfast: Enjoy a warm and energizing breakfast before starting your descent.
  • Trek Down: Trek back to Ransi village, reaching by evening.
  • Rest & Departure: Rest for an hour at Ransi and depart for Delhi on the same day.
  • Morning (around 7–8 AM): Reach Delhi with beautiful memories, divine blessings, and lots of positive vibes from the journey.
  • Please Note: Arrival time may vary depending on traffic and road conditions in the hills.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

Accommodation

  • 1 night stay in Guest House / Homestay at Ransi Village
  • 1 night stay in Tented Camp / Basic Lodge near Madmaheshwar Temple

Meals

  • Breakfast and dinner included (all veg)
  • Hygienic and nutritious meals to keep your energy high

Transport

  • Private Traveller / Vehicle from Delhi to Ransi to Delhi
  • Comfortable and safe travel with experienced drivers

Trekking Arrangements

  • Qualified and experienced trek guide
  • Complete camping equipment: tents, sleeping bags, mattresses
  • Local support staff for assistance during the trek

Not included in your package

  • Meals during the transportation
  • 5% GST is not included
  • Any expenses or items not mentioned in the inclusion section
  • Any expenses arising from emergencies during the trek
  • Any personal expenses
  • Cost of snow chains or 4x4 and 4x2 vehicles
